title: Joe Strutter, Davy Jones and John Marrero
summary: Discussion of drummer Joe Strutter, Professor Davy Jones (saxophonist who went to New York and California) and guitarist/banjoist John Marrero.

story.theme_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section: instruments and players
